blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— Four persons stranded on an island off Bislig City were rescued on Thursday after rough seas forced them to abandon their voyage the previous day, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) reported on Saturday. The Coast Guard Sub-Station Bislig said the group—composed of a boat operator and three passengers—was traveling aboard a small motorized outrigger (pakura) from Hagonoy Island to Barangay Labisma Wednesday afternoon. While en route, the vessel was battered by strong waves, causing seawater to breach the hull. The operator aborted the trip and turned back to seek refuge on Hagonoy Island. An initial effort […]...
